summary.motive: Bait the quarterback into throwing a boundary intermediate out-route against what appears to be soft Quarters cushion, only for the boundary corner to trap the route while the safety caps deep.
summary.keyDefender: LCB (Boundary Corner) timing the trap break and BS (Boundary Safety) capping deep vertical routes
summary.whyItWorks: Quarterbacks are taught to take the quick boundary out against Quarters off-coverage; Cover 8 trap turns a high-percentage throw into a pick-six.
summary.failureMode: Quarterback pumps the out-route and hits the sideline seam before the safety reaches the deep half.

beats.title: Two-High Safety Shell Disguise
beats.text: The defense presents the standard 2-high pre-snap look with LCB giving a soft 6.5-yard cushion on X, inviting the quick sideline out throw on 3rd down.

beats.title: Boundary Corner Bait & Trap
beats.text: As X stems to 8 yards and breaks toward the sideline, LCB plants his back foot and undercuts the out-route with full acceleration in Cover 8 trap.

beats.title: Safety Caps the Deep Post
beats.text: Boundary Safety BS rotates over top of the vacated corner to cap H on the vertical post, sealing the deep half against any double-move.

beats.title: Underneath Interception Trap
beats.text: LCB jumps in front of the sideline pass for a game-changing interception and pick-six return as the QB is caught in the split-field trap.

relations.tell: Boundary corner squats and traps out-route underneath while Boundary safety rotates over top.
